category.reason: The task requires comparing the account’s relative performance on the radar chart, identifying the strongest capability, and locating its associated improvement-suggestions link.

instruction.en: View the improvement suggestions for the strongest capability on the current account's radar chart.
instruction.zh: 查看当前账号雷达图中能力最强项的提升建议。

reference.patch: Replaced the original English and Chinese instructions to view the note-data overview with a bilingual request to view improvement suggestions for the strongest capability on the account’s radar chart. Changed groundTruth from [1345.0, 798.0, 1439.0, 509.0] to [738.0, 3488.0, 787.0, 3351.0] in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates, moving the target from the note-data overview tab to the improvement-suggestions link for 发文活跃度, the strongest dimension on the radar chart, which exceeds 95% of comparable creators. Changed category.item from Functional to Reasoning and updated category.reason to describe comparing the displayed dimensions.
